decision: At Monday 01 UTC compare Saturday's spot closing price with the closes 28 and 84 days earlier. If both returns are positive hold a long perpetual. If both are negative hold a short perpetual. Otherwise stay flat on that market. Keep the same units while the direction stays unchanged. Close reversing legs before any new entry. All trades are virtual.
risk_and_cost: Start each period separately with 1000 USDT cash, 20% of marked account value per new leg, public lot steps rounded down. At entry cap total gross marked exposure at equity. Pay 0.06% fee plus 0.10% adverse fill on every side. Settle actual signed WhiteBIT funding on the actual position held. Require full hourly open/high/low and funding coverage on held markets. Flag any 10% gross maintenance breach even at simultaneous adversarial intrabar extremes. Value each weekly mark net of closing costs, including time flat.
controls: Cash; continuous long; continuous short; reverse of the trend signals. Controls use identical position sizing, costs, margin and funding. The historical market regimes have been seen in other experiments.
eligibility: Both separate periods must yield positive net after stress, beat perpetual long, perpetual short and inverted signals, and stay collateralized. Compare all 52 weeks against 2% on the whole account, and report both sides and drawdown. No forward activation if any condition fails.
